configurePresets.name: win

configurePresets.description: Pass -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=<abs>/Config/cmake/toolchain-clangcl-xwin.cmake. CMake resolves toolchain files relative to the build dir, so it cannot be expressed portably in a preset.
